offering_description.value: Develops, markets and sells shelf-stable and frozen packaged foods, including vegetables, baking ingredients, spices, snacks and cereals. Sells mainly to grocery chains, mass merchants and foodservice distributors across the United States.

primary_products.value: shelf-stable vegetables; frozen vegetables; baking ingredients; spices and seasonings; snacks; hot cereal

items.detail: grocery chains, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors
branded packaged food sold to retailers and distributors
owns and markets food brands, sold to grocery retailers and distributors
produces and packages food, partly through co-manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.detail: sold across the United States, with some sales in Canada and other countries

specialization.detail: several packaged food lines sharing grocery retail customers and distribution channels

regulatory_exposure.detail: food safety, labeling and nutrition rules enforced by FDA and USDA
